notes: Verdict accept after in-place corrections. The texts read are arXiv:1608.08882v2 (SHA-256 08578ca1…6430, matching the record) and v1 (ffbb6696…3b94), and, for E4–E8, André's arXiv:1609.00345v1 and published Appendix A. The published Inventiones text is still unobtainable (G1), so the findings stay scoped to v2, and sourceVersions now says so: collation.py classifies the paper as read in preprint. All ten recorded mistakes are confirmed. Fifteen are added (E11–E25). Among them are two gaps in the reductions of the main proofs: Theorem 5.4's proof uses p-adic completeness it never arranged (E14, with a counterexample to the displayed isomorphism), and Theorem 6.1's proof omits the mixed-characteristic and completion reductions that v1 made (E15). One further addition is a misprint in Proposition 5.2(1) (K for K°, E13). Five remark items (Remarks 1.3, 1.8, 2.4, 2.5 and 5.5) are removed; their content moved to briefs, reasons and notes. Eight items are added: tilt, pro-tower, algebra-adjoint, cohen-structure, residue-field-extension, derived-local-reduction, perfect-cone-detection and perfect-cone-limit. The result has 89 items (65 missing, 14 planned, 10 library). Thirty-eight items have statement, proof-step, prerequisite, locator or note fixes, and six more only a corrected owner; admissible-blowup is now planned by StableReduction layer 4. Routes 6 and 7 re-planned Tau Ceti content and closed cycles through R2; both are corrected in place, and all nine routes are accepted. For the orchestrator: three links are needed, each closing no cycle: DD.1 → P2, E2 → R03.1 (or a direct statement in R03.1) and StableReduction layer 4 → SF.4. CC.2 and D7 should import E2's derived inverse limit, and AdicCoefficientsAndComparisons L5 SF.4's flattening. E4–E8 are André's misprints: E5–E8 duplicate PAPER-ANDRE-18-B/E11, E1, E2 and E10, and E4 is missing there. Details in research/blueprint/reviews/REV-PAPER-BHATT-18.md.
